title: Death Note Relight 2: L's Successors
description: L’s successor must ponder L’s defeat if he hopes to succeed where his famed predecessor failed. At the headquarters of the SPK, he calls upon the Japanese task force to declare war on Light. A recap of Death Note episodes 27–37, with new footage.
